_comment: Known-answer fixture for the SuSiE engine, recorded from the seeded demo
60 and 140) at the commit that moved SuSiE onto sushie.
Purpose: the shape/argmax assertions elsewhere in the suite all still pass
if a future sushie release quietly shifts PIP magnitudes, reorders alpha
rows against CSIndex, or changes the scale of mu/mu2. This pins the actual
numbers so that drift fails loudly instead.
If a sushie upgrade legitimately changes these, re-record them in the same
commit as the version bump and say why in the PR - do not widen the
tolerances to make a red test green.

recorded_from.call: run_susie(z=demo.z, R=demo.R, n=5000, L=10)  # all other args default
